findings.evidence: Chromium executed the unique alert marker supplied through the search URL fragment.
findings.recommendation: Avoid rendering untrusted search input as HTML; use safe text bindings.

findings.evidence: PUT product review was accepted and the raw iframe marker was returned by a later independent GET. No victim session was accessed.
findings.recommendation: Contextually encode stored reviews before rendering and apply a restrictive Content-Security-Policy.

findings.evidence: Basket object read: GET /rest/basket/1 returned a basket owned by UserId 1 without an object-level authorization error. No basket contents are retained in the report.
findings.recommendation: Enforce object-level authorization and verify the basket belongs to the authenticated user before returning it.

findings.evidence: GET search: baseline and false SQL predicate returned zero products; the paired true predicate returned 46 products. Only product counts are retained.
findings.recommendation: Use parameterized queries for the search criteria.

findings.evidence: The HTML response is missing security response headers: Content-Security-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Set Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options and X-Content-Type-Options on application responses.
